Functor of points.
For any <MATH_0001> there is a contravariant
functor
<MATH_0002>
which takes an object <MATH_0003> to the set
<MATH_0004>. In other words <MATH_0005> is a presheaf.
Given a morphism <MATH_0006> the corresponding map
<MATH_0007>
takes <MATH_0008> to <MATH_0009>. We will always denote
this presheaf <MATH_0010>.
It is called the <TEXTITOPEN_0001>representable presheaf<TEXTITCLOSE_0001> associated to <MATH_0011>.
If <MATH_0012> is the category of schemes this functor is
sometimes referred to as the
<EMPHOPEN_0001>functor of points<EMPHCLOSE_0001> of <MATH_0013>.
